title: Eight Years' Wanderings in Ceylon
author: Baker, Samuel White, Sir
description: "Eight Years' Wanderings in Ceylon" by Sir Samuel White Baker is an exploratory travelogue written during the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This work recounts the author’s adventurous experiences and observations while he attempts to settle in Ceylon (now Sri Lanka), engaging deeply with its landscapes, cultures, and challenges.

authorInfo.bio: Baker, Samuel White, Sir (1821–1893) wrote The Rifle and the Hound in Ceylon. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
